title: Profit & Margin
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Gross margin %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(l.line_amount - l.line_cost) / sum(l.line_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN dash_demo.products p2 USING (product_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Gross profit
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(l.line_amount - l.line_cost), 2) FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN dash_demo.products p2 USING (product_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Discounts given
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(l.qty * l.unit_price * l.discount_pct / 100.0), 2) FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN dash_demo.products p2 USING (product_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

density.rule: every cell of the margin heatmap stands on real order lines
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN dash_demo.products p2 USING (product_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY p2.category, date_trunc('quarter', o.order_ts))
